claims.claim: Exact codeword likelihood is obtained by marginalizing over all latent state trajectories.
claims.reason: Hidden-state posterior marginalization is foundational BCJR/sum-product inference and is already used in phase-noise decoding.

claims.claim: Enumerate per-state sorted lists, fully score encountered words, and stop when the best complete score exceeds the sum of current queue heads.
claims.reason: This is a top-1 sum-aggregation threshold algorithm specialization with code membership acting as a feasibility predicate.

claims.claim: Use FEC/code validity to discriminate among candidate constellation rotations or phase hypotheses.
claims.reason: Code-aided phase-hypothesis discrimination and cycle-slip-aware FEC are established in papers and patents.

claims.claim: Generate a small candidate-codeword list and apply a complete channel/state-marginal metric to choose the final word.
claims.reason: Short-code list construction followed by a complete noncoherent metric and adaptive list sizing are known.

claims.claim: Globally order state-conditioned word components for a sparse persistent automorphism channel and interleave them with arbitrary-code membership queries.
claims.reason: All ingredients have close predecessors, but the reviewed sources did not disclose the identical frozen intra-packet automorphism/component-merge construction.

claims.claim: Return the first valid codeword in the globally ordered sparse latent-cause stream as a practical max-witness decoder for one persistent QPSK slip.
claims.reason: First-valid GRAND and phase-candidate selection are known, but no reviewed source was found with this exact intra-packet sparse-cause/global-component ordering and arbitrary membership interface.

claims.claim: Invoke complete marginal rescoring only for an adaptively bounded two-codeword latent list when an ambiguity trigger rejects first-valid confidence.
claims.reason: Adaptive lists and complete rescoring are known separately; novelty can only be claimed for the precise trigger/order/interface combination after further search.

claims.claim: Screen a binary linear code against one-slip QPSK affine transformations using the consistency/rank system H A G^T u = H b.
claims.reason: Phase-equivariant and rotationally robust coding are established, but the exact target-length affine intersection audit was not found identically in the reviewed sources.

claims.claim: Activate the latent-state search only after a tracker alarm, syndrome/CRC failure, or other event detector.
claims.reason: Event-triggered or adaptive invocation is common; it is needed for practical overhead but is not a novelty pillar.

claims.claim: A general field-defining group-action decoder for arbitrary latent transformation channels.
claims.reason: The current evidence is one synthetic QPSK slip family and does not support a general or field-defining claim.

claims.claim: The current unseen-codeword certificate is both novel and practically efficient exact marginal-ML decoding.
claims.reason: The generic threshold structure is anticipated and commit ed5a4b4 showed the practical exact-certificate gate failed.

claims.claim: The work is currently a field-defining candidate.
claims.reason: Formal novelty, optimized matched baselines, structured codes, physical relevance, and implementation-level evidence remain incomplete.

allowed_supporting_statements: The exact marginal decoder is a correctness oracle and approximation benchmark, not the practical flagship.
The present evidence supports a search-coordinate advantage for early and middle one-slip QPSK events.
Orbit screening is required; very-high-rate low-redundancy codes are not unrestricted targets.
Any practical advantage must survive optimized event-triggered state-aware baselines and a defensible physical model.
blocked_phrases: general solution to continuous phase noise
language.novelty_qualifier: To the best of our knowledge after the frozen scientific search, the identical combination of sparse intra-packet persistent automorphism-component ordering, arbitrary-code membership, adaptive first-valid/L=2 operation, and explicit orbit screening was not found. This is a provisional scientific novelty position, not a patent-validity or freedom-to-operate opinion.
language.primary_claim: For a frozen zero-or-one persistent QPSK phase-jump model, we study a code-agnostic latent-cause guessing receiver that globally orders state-conditioned candidate components and invokes an arbitrary code-membership oracle. The practical modes are first-valid decoding and an adaptively invoked two-codeword list with complete state-marginal rescoring. We measure actual noisy rank compression, tail work, and affine orbit safety against matched state-aware receivers.
language.working_title: Sparse Latent-Cause Guessing for Rare Persistent QPSK Phase-State Jumps

oracle: exact marginal LS-GRAND on tractable cases

targets: [64,45,8] or a verified nearby extended BCH configuration

mandatory_repairs: Use eligible_work_pairs, not all paired_trials, for work-ratio sample thresholds.
matched_baselines: event-triggered all-state OSD with the identical cached state metric kernel
C4 forward-backward/BCJR state inference followed by a strong code decoder
decode-every-state strong code-specific decoder with complete candidate reranking
ordinary no-slip decoder plus the same trigger
pilot-assisted and differential alternatives at equal information bits, packet duration, bandwidth, and energy
next_gate.objective: Determine whether LS-FV/LS-A2 retains a tail-work or net-overhead advantage against optimized matched receivers on structured codes in a defensible residual-cycle-slip model.
pass_conditions: Across at least two structured code families, LS-FV or LS-A2 has no preregistered material reliability loss versus the strongest matched practical receiver.
At least one physically defensible region shows approximately 10x or greater p99 normalized-work reduction, or a clear equal-net-rate pilot/energy advantage.
No-slip p99 overhead remains small under the measured event rate and event trigger.
Orbit screening removes exact ambiguity without unacceptable redundancy.
The conclusion survives prior, phase-drift, and one-extra-jump mismatch.

physical_anchor.preferred: coherent optical QPSK residual cycle slips after a conventional carrier-phase estimator
physical_anchor.wireless_alternative: pilot-limited short burst only after a trace, hardware-emulated process, or defensible standards/oscillator/tracker-derived model is supplied

report: unconditional BLER weighted by event rate
statistics.stopping: at least 200 relevant errors per primary point or a preregistered confidence-width rule

stop_conditions: Optimized event-triggered BCJR or code-specific state sweep is within roughly 2x in p99 work at equivalent reliability.
The physical event rate is too small for unconditional benefit after normal-frame overhead.
Residual continuous phase uncertainty destroys concentration on a small state set.
The narrowed approximate combination is directly anticipated by a newly found source or blocking patent claim.
Structured target codes exhibit unavoidable orbit ambiguity.
